verdict.rationale: Simular documents several first-party ways to run Sai without a UI: a REST API, a Python SDK and an MCP server that let your own code send plain-language tasks to cloud computers. The API also streams progress events and accepts programmatic approvals, and there is a standalone simulang CLI and scheduled reruns. That covers headless, programmatic automation, but CI use is only implied and approval prompts may interrupt unattended runs. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs or examples (e.g., a CI pipeline recipe), a documented fully non-interactive mode without approval gates, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration.
